notes.title: Full Virtual Reality support added
notes.content:
We're delighted to announce that the latest version of Planet Smasher now includes full support for all current Virtual Reality platforms - HTC Vive, Oculus Rift & Controller / Oculus Rift & Touch and OSVR - allowing gameplay across fully three-dimensional grids (up/down, left/right, forward/back), as well as 2D play on a monitor.

Since the first release we've also made a number of small tweaks, notably improving the layout of the menus, adding fully configurable controllers, and adding background music.

If there are any other features you'd like to see, please just let us know!
